6 تراجموا بَالحِجَارَةِ They threw, or cast, stones, one at another; or vied, or contended for superiority, in throwing, or casting, stones, one at another: (S, TA:) and ↓ ارتجموا signifies the like of this. (IAar, TA. [See also 3.]) ―
-b2- [Hence,] تراجمت الإِبِلُ: see 8. ―
-b3- And تراجموا بِالكَلَامِ (tropical:) They reviled one another; or vied in reviling one another. (TA. [See, again, 3.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
